mil7.2.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, dīpiniyā ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.2.4:1.2: Yathā mahārāja dīpinī sakiṃ yeva gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti, na punappunaṃ purisaṃ upeti,
mil7.2.4:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena āyati paṭisandhiṃ uppattiṃ gabbhaseyyaṃ cutiṃ bhedaṃ khayaṃ vināsaṃ saṃsārabhayaṃ duggatiṃ visamaṃ sampīḷitaṃ disvā: punabbhave na paṭisandahissāmīti yoniso manasikāro karaṇīyo.
mil7.2.4:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja dīpiniyā ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.2.4:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Suttanipāte Dhaniyagopālakasutte:
